video_summary.overall_goal: Create a new text file named demo.txt inside the Amaze2595 folder using the '+' FAB, then repeat the same file-creation flow to demonstrate a duplicate-name bug.
video_summary.description: The video shows the Amaze file manager app open on an empty folder (/storage/emulated/0/Download/Amaze2595). The user taps the '+' FAB, selects 'File', types a name in the New File dialog, and taps CREATE. The action is performed twice with the identical name 'demo.txt', resulting in two files with the same name coexisting in the same directory.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Amaze file manager showing empty folder /storage/emulated/0/Download/Amaze2595 with 'No Files' placeholder and a pink '+' FAB bottom-right.
steps.system_response: FAB expands into a speed-dial menu with 'Folder', 'File', 'Cloud Connection' options.
steps.visual_feedback: Speed-dial menu items animate in above the FAB; FAB icon changes to 'X'.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Speed-dial menu with Folder, File, Cloud Connection options overlaid on the empty folder view.
steps.system_response: 'New File' dialog opens with a text field pre-filled with '.txt' and a warning that the created file will be hidden in the file list.
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog fades in with CANCEL / CREATE buttons.
steps.intent_task: Choose to create a new file

steps.what_screen_is_visible: New File dialog with text field. User clears the pre-filled '.txt', triggering a 'Field can't be empty' error, then types 'demo.txt' via on-screen keyboard.
steps.system_response: Field updates character by character: 'd' -> 'de' -> 'demo' -> 'demo.t' -> 'demo.txt'; error clears once text is non-empty.
steps.visual_feedback: Autocomplete suggestion bar shows 'demo', 'demon', 'democracy' while typing; error message appears/disappears.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Dialog showing 'demo.txt' entered in the field.
steps.system_response: Dialog closes, folder view now shows '0 folders and 1 files' with a 'demo.txt' entry (red text-file icon, timestamp 9:11 PM) and a transient 'Creating File' snackbar.
steps.visual_feedback: New file list item appears with red icon; 'Creating File' toast shown at bottom.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Folder now lists demo.txt (9:11 PM). User taps the '+' FAB again, then 'File' again, reopening the New File dialog with '.txt' pre-filled.
steps.system_response: New File dialog reopens with '.txt' pre-filled and hidden-file warning, same as step 2.
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog re-appears over the file list that now shows the existing demo.txt behind it.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: User clears '.txt' (triggering 'Field can't be empty'), then types 'demo' followed by '.txt' again via keyboard and autocomplete, re-entering the identical filename 'demo.txt' used in step 3.
steps.system_response: Field updates: '' -> 'd' -> 'de' -> 'demo' -> 'demo.' -> 'demo.tx' -> 'demo.txt'. No warning or error is shown indicating a filename collision with the existing demo.txt.
steps.visual_feedback: Only the generic 'recommended to use .txt extension' hint appears; no duplicate-name warning at any point.
steps.intent_task: Name the second new file 'demo.txt' (same name as the first)

steps.screen_name: Amaze - Folder view with 2 files (bug state)
steps.what_screen_is_visible: Folder now shows '0 folders and 2 files' with TWO separate list entries both named 'demo.txt' — one at 9:11 PM (red icon) and a new one at 9:12 PM (grey/generic icon, not yet fully rendered), plus a 'Creating File' snackbar.
steps.system_response: App creates a second file with an identical name instead of rejecting the operation, overwriting, or prompting to rename/replace. Both files persist as distinct entries.
steps.visual_feedback: Duplicate 'demo.txt' entries visible simultaneously in the same folder listing.

overall_flow: Tap + FAB -> File -> New File dialog
Type 'demo.txt' and tap CREATE -> demo.txt created (9:11 PM)
Repeat: tap + FAB -> File -> New File dialog
Type identical name 'demo.txt' again and tap CREATE
Bug: second demo.txt created alongside the first, producing two files with the same name in one folder
human_readable_step_summary: User opens the empty Amaze2595 download folder.
User taps the + button and chooses 'File' to create a new file.
User clears the default '.txt' text and types 'demo.txt', then taps CREATE.
demo.txt is created and appears in the file list at 9:11 PM.
User repeats the same steps: + button -> File -> New File dialog.
User types the exact same name 'demo.txt' again and taps CREATE.
The app creates a second file also named 'demo.txt' (9:12 PM) instead of blocking/renaming/warning about the duplicate, leaving two identically named files in the same folder.
